title: shell-tools operations
description: The JSON operations, selected by `op`. Each reply carries ok; a failure is {ok: false, error}. Paths are relative to the caller's working directory. Every field is listed in the README.

entities.name: read
entities.description: A file's lines, whole or in ranges, capped.
entities.transport: zazzle call '{"op":"read",...}' (or stdin with -); MCP tool zazzle_call
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; any path the user can read.
entities.result: path, etag, total_lines, chunks [{start, end, text}], ref; truncated, next_ranges and bytes_omitted when capped; long_lines_cut; or unchanged, or hunks with changed and base_etag, or binary with size.
failures: A path that is not a regular file.
A range with start 0 or end before start.

entities.name: search
entities.description: A regex or literal search grouped by file.
entities.transport: zazzle call '{"op":"search",...}' (or stdin with -); MCP tool zazzle_call
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; any path the user can read.
entities.result: results [{path, hits | blocks}], files_matched, total_matches (matching lines), truncated; with files_only, files instead of results; etag and ref, or unchanged.
failures: A pattern that does not compile.
A path that does not exist.

entities.name: list
entities.description: Files and directories below a directory, paged.
entities.transport: zazzle call '{"op":"list",...}' (or stdin with -); MCP tool zazzle_call
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; any path the user can read.
entities.result: entries (directories end in /; [path, size, mtime] with long), total, truncated and next_cursor; etag and ref, or unchanged.
failures: A path that does not exist or is not a directory.

entities.name: stat
entities.transport: zazzle call '{"op":"stat",...}' (or stdin with -); MCP tool zazzle_call; also zazzle stat PATH.. [--hash] and MCP zazzle_stat
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; any path the user can read.
entities.result: path, exists, kind (file, dir, symlink, other), size, mtime, and etag of the content with hash.
failures: hash on a file that cannot be read.

entities.name: outline
entities.transport: zazzle call '{"op":"outline",...}' (or stdin with -); MCP tool zazzle_call
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; any path the user can read.
entities.result: files [{path, symbols [[start, end, kind, name]]}], total_symbols, truncated; etag and ref, or unchanged.
failures: A path that does not exist.

entities.name: diff_since
entities.description: Hunks since a version the session was sent.
entities.transport: zazzle call '{"op":"diff_since",...}' (or stdin with -); MCP tool zazzle_call
entities.authorization: Callers of the daemon's own uid; any path the user can read.
entities.result: path, base_etag, etag, newlines, hunks, ref; or unchanged.
failures: base_unavailable: the version is not held.
A file that cannot be read.

relatedViews.relationship: The call and stat commands that run them.
